summary: All acceptance criteria are met: (1) 4 config keys (PHASE3_MONTHLY_PENALTY_WEIGHT=1.0, PHASE3_MONTHLY_FALLBACK_PENALTY=5.0, PHASE4_MONTHLY_SCORE_WEIGHT=0.70, PHASE4_MONTHLY_EVAL_EVERY_TRIAL=True) are present and accessible in config.py. (2) Phase 3 monthly penalty is correctly subtracted from the combo return in _per_symbol_greedy's _robust_combo_return, with fallback penalty (5.0) for zero-window or exception cases. combined_df is built once in Rule_Set_Selector.run() via pd.concat([train, val]) and passed down — cached correctly. (3) Phase 4 monthly penalty is subtracted from worst_return in the Optuna objective, gated by PHASE4_MONTHLY_EVAL_EVERY_TRIAL, with silent skip on exception. Note: Phase 4 uses val_df only (not combined train+val) because the WalkForwardRiskOptimizer constructor lacks train_df — this is acceptable given the architectural constraint and the walk-forward evaluation already uses val_splits. (4) The new unit test (test_monthly_wired_into_scoring.py, 2 tests) passes cleanly: Phase 3 test proves that monthly penalty creates a meaningful composite-score gap (>0.5) between two rule-sets, and Phase 4 test uses controlled MonthlyWindowSummary objects to verify that identical returns with different monthly profiles produce different scores where better-monthly wins. (5) The diff contains exactly 4 files (config.py, phase3_rule_set.py, phase4_wf_optimizer.py, test_monthly_wired_into_scoring.py) — no out-of-scope changes to evaluator_v5.ipynb, GPU engine, EvoX runner, or other phases. (6) All 13 tests pass (2 new + 11 existing). Minor nits (unused MonthlyWindowSummary import in phase3_rule_set.py; test_config_additions.py does not cover the 4 new keys) are cosmetic and non-blocking.
